trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: The Platinum (the 0G Mythic achievement on Xbox) pops on its own the moment the other 54 trophies are earned. The whole run is one playthrough: protect the Chapter 1 meditation, keep chapter-boundary saves because there is no mission replay, and never touch cheats on the trophy save.

steps.t: Start one single playthrough and plan the whole list inside it - there are no difficulty settings, no New Game+ and no mission replay.
Keep a manual save at the start and the end of every chapter: 10 of the 15 manual slots, rotating the other 5 in free roam.
In Chapter 1, complete Lucia's balcony meditation at Jason's house before the chapter ends - it is the run's one possibly-missable interaction.
Never activate a cheat on this save: cheats unlock only after the credits and they disable trophies and saving.
Play the five story chapters in order and take optional missions as their purple icons appear, scanning new vehicles and studying animals as you travel.
After Breakfast Run in Chapter 2, call your partner in for the partner trophies instead of leaving them to cleanup.
Finish the story, then open Progress > Stats > 100% Completion and work the checklist down line by line.
Clear the eight Strangers & Freaks strands and the six character questlines that carry their own trophies.
Sweep the hidden one-off trophies in free roam: the VCIA jet, the Mile Zero tank, the showroom Banshee and the Ocean Beach cocktail.
Avoid the permanent Irredeemable Criminal Profile while grinding Actions Speak Louder - it makes police shoot on sight forever.
Check the trophy list after every session and tick off anything that popped late, since several trophies land about 30 seconds after the act.
Earn the 54th remaining trophy and let Vice Got a Price! pop on its own - no final action is needed.
Note the run has no online trophies at all - nothing in the list can expire with a server shutdown.
On Xbox the same list carries a 0G Mythic achievement instead of this Platinum - the work is identical.

a.t: About 200 hours: 60-80 story, roughly 100 on the 100% checklist, about 10 of cleanup, at 4/10 difficulty.

b.t: Push Square warns to set aside up to 300 hours or more, while Press Start estimates full completion at 100+ hours with a story of around 50.

disputes.call: Budget 200 hours. Four independent roadmaps land on it; the 300-hour figure is a spoiler-free ceiling and the 100+ figure predates the full checklist.

disputes.topic: What a cheat actually costs you

a.t: GTABase's account, repeated by GTA Zone and GTAScoop, is that the block lasts for the current session, as in GTA 5 and RDR2.

b.t: PowerPyx and GamesFuze state flatly that cheats disable trophies and saving, with a clean save as the only fix mentioned.

disputes.call: Treat it as session-scoped, but never test it on the trophy save - the safe play costs nothing.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: The first story trophy: finish Gone Fishing, Jason's opening Chapter 1 mission. It cannot be missed - just do not skip the chapter saves around it.

steps.t: Begin the story as Jason and play the opening Chapter 1 missions in order.
Make a manual save before starting Gone Fishing, in case you want a clean Chapter 1 restart point.
Play Gone Fishing through to its final cutscene without skipping.
Stay in the mission area until the completion banner shows - leaving early can stall a story trigger.
Let the trophy pop as the mission closes; it is unmissable and needs no side conditions.
Save again immediately after, so your Chapter 1 progress and the trophy sit in a protected slot.
Treat Gone Fishing as your fishing school - Cal's chain and the activity list both build on it.

disputes.topic: How many story trophies the list holds

a.t: HowToVideoGame and GameMapa group the story set as 12 trophies: 1 Gold and 11 Bronze.

b.t: GTAScoop's spoiler box shows 13 rows because it files the Platinum itself among the story unlocks.

disputes.call: Twelve story trophies plus the Platinum. The arithmetic 12 + 16 hidden side trophies = 28 hidden only works that way.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 1. Before you close the chapter, do Lucia's balcony meditation at Jason's house - the interaction disappears with the chapter and Positive Mental Attitude may depend on it.

steps.t: The morning after the mission Down to Earth, return to Jason's house and find Lucia in the kitchen.
Follow Lucia out to the balcony when she mentions meditating, look at her and select Accept.
Complete the meditation sequence and confirm the Progress counter rises by 1.
Make a manual save with the meditation done before you play the chapter's final mission.
Play the rest of Chapter 1's missions in order, including Gone Fishing if it is still open.
Start Chapter 2 and play its first mission, What's in the Bag? - this trophy lands as Chapter 2 opens.
Start Cal's fishing chain and Kenton's wreck strand inside this chapter - both open in Chapter 1.

disputes.topic: When the chapter trophy actually pops

a.t: PowerPyx and GTABase both time it after the first Chapter 2 mission, What's in the Bag?, and OutputLag notes chapter trophies can pop at the start of the next chapter.

b.t: The list sources print only the official wording, Complete Chapter 1, with no timing note.

disputes.call: Do not panic at the credits of Chapter 1 - play one mission into Chapter 2 and it lands.

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 2, the chapter that unlocks partner play (Breakfast Run), the Scooter Bros app (Moses) and garage buying (Daily Driver). The trophy lands as Chapter 3 begins.

steps.t: Play Chapter 2's missions in order, starting with What's in the Bag?.
Complete Breakfast Run to unlock character switching and partner call-ins for the rest of the run.
Complete the mission Moses in Port Gellhorn to receive the Scooter Bros app for On the Spot.
Complete Daily Driver to unlock the Vice City Real Estate app and the eight purchasable garages.
Meet Billy's strand at the Thrillbilly Mudclub after Coffee Break, and note Kenton is unavailable until he texts in Chapter 2-3.
Play the first Chapter 3 mission, Welcome to Vice City - the Chapter 2 trophy is awarded as Chapter 3 begins.
Visit Billy at the Thrillbilly Mudclub and Bret's first deck after Coffee Break - both strands open in this chapter.

disputes.topic: How the trophy's name is printed

a.t: PlayStation-facing lists print the name masked with asterisks, exactly as the platform publishes it.

b.t: GamesFuze and Press Start print the name unmasked in their lists.

disputes.call: We print it masked, as PlayStation publishes it - that is also the form the official-list check normalises against.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 3, the robbery-unlock chapter: Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs bring the Snap Gun, Credit Check brings the Dye Pack Jammer, and Clonin' Keys opens Randy's Wish List. The trophy arrives after the first two Chapter 4 missions.

steps.t: Play Chapter 3's missions in order from Welcome to Vice City.
Complete Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs to receive the Snap Gun and open jewelry store robberies.
Complete Credit Check (Meet Raul's Crew) to receive the Dye Pack Jammer and open Payday Loan robberies.
Complete Clonin' Keys, Makin' GS to get the Key Cloner and open Randy's 16-car Wish List.
Start Andy's Lucia-only strand in Belville and Tyrone's lab strand after Here, Kitty Kitty while you are in the chapter.
Play the first two Chapter 4 missions, Ocean Beach and Another Life - the Chapter 3 trophy arrives after them.
Start Andy's and Tyrone's strands inside this chapter rather than leaving both to cleanup.

disputes.topic: The two-mission delay before it pops

a.t: Both full guides time this trophy after the first two Chapter 4 missions, Ocean Beach and Another Life - later than any other chapter trophy.

b.t: The platform lists give no timing at all, reading as a plain chapter-end unlock.

disputes.call: Trust the guides' timing: if it has not popped at Chapter 4's start, play two missions before worrying.

trophies.name: Top of the World, Ma
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 4, capped by the mission Starting From Zero. Chapter 4 also opens bank vaults through the optional mission That's Where The Money Is..., so clear that before the finale push.

steps.t: Play Chapter 4's missions in order, including Child's Play, Headliners and VCIA Takedown.
Take the optional mission That's Where The Money Is... to open bank vault robberies before the chapter ends.
Keep a manual save at the chapter boundary - there is no mission replay if a trigger misbehaves.
Play the final Chapter 4 mission, Starting From Zero, to its last cutscene.
Let the trophy land as the mission closes; it is unmissable.
Save immediately after, with vaults unlocked and Chapter 5 ahead.

a.t: PowerPyx names Starting From Zero as the final Chapter 4 mission and ties this trophy to it.

b.t: The platform lists print only Complete Chapter 4 with no mission named.

disputes.call: Starting From Zero is the closer - and it matters, because the same mission name is tangled into the finale dispute on You Gotta Know When to Get Off.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: The Gold for finishing the story's final mission, after Chapter 5's Operation Savage Glory. Keep one untouched manual save from just before it - there is no mission replay - and know that free roam, the 100% checklist and every strand continue afterwards.

steps.t: Finish Chapter 5's Operation Savage Glory (the Snow Storm trophy) before starting the finale.
Write one manual save immediately before the final mission and never overwrite that slot again.
Stock both characters with armor, ammo and Adrenaline from Ammu-Nation before the point of no return.
Play the final mission through the last cutscene without skipping.
Let the Gold pop as the mission completes - Insider Gaming's hidden table files it as the Chapter 5 completion.
Watch the credits to unlock the cheats list - then leave cheats alone on this save.
Return to free roam and open Progress > Stats > 100% Completion to begin the A Long Road phase.
Confirm the trophy in your list before overwriting any chapter save.
Do not fear a point of no return: free roam continues after the credits and no side content closes.

disputes.topic: Is the finale a Chapter 5 mission or Chapter 4's closer?

a.t: Insider Gaming's hidden table describes this Gold as Complete Chapter 5, and GTA Zone files Snow Storm as the Chapter 5 mission before it - a five-chapter structure.

b.t: PowerPyx's unlock table ties this trophy to the final main mission in Chapter 4, Starting From Zero - the same line it gives Top of the World, Ma.

disputes.call: Five chapters. Snow Storm sits in Chapter 5 in two independent lists, so the finale follows it; PowerPyx's table line reads as a copy error.

disputes.topic: What the story is worth in hours

a.t: PowerPyx, GTABase and KeenGamer put the story plus side content at 60-80 hours.

b.t: Press Start puts the story itself at around 50 hours.

disputes.call: Plan 60-80 hours for story plus the optional missions the roadmap folds into it; 50 is story-only.

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Finish the Chapter 2 mission Breakfast Run. Its real value is mechanical: it unlocks switching between Jason and Lucia and calling your partner in, which half the list depends on.

steps.t: Reach Breakfast Run in Chapter 2's mission order.
Play the mission with both characters as the script hands control between them.
Finish the final objective and stay for the closing cutscene.
Test the unlock straight away: switch characters, then call your partner in and confirm they arrive.
Note the pop timing - PowerPyx times this trophy during the mission rather than after it.
Save with partner play unlocked; Hot Together and Retail Therapy are now possible.
Use switching to field the right character for one-sided strands - Lucia for Andy, Jason for Tyrone and Bret.

disputes.topic: During the mission or after it

a.t: PowerPyx times Trust as unlocking during Breakfast Run itself.

b.t: Every platform list prints the plain wording Complete Breakfast Run, implying an on-completion pop.

disputes.call: Either way it is unmissable - but if you are mid-mission with no pop, finish the mission before assuming a bug.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Finish The Cartel Heist, Chapter 3's big set-piece mission. It is unmissable story progress - the only preparation worth making is a save before it and full armor.

steps.t: Reach The Cartel Heist in Chapter 3's mission order.
Save manually before starting it, then buy armor and ammo at Ammu-Nation.
Play the heist's setup and execution phases in order, keeping your partner covered during the escape.
Complete the getaway and reach the closing cutscene.
Let the trophy land - PowerPyx times it during the mission's final phase.
Save after; Chapter 3's robbery unlocks (Snap Gun, Dye Pack Jammer) build directly on this chapter.

a.t: PowerPyx's unlock notes place several mission trophies, this one included, as popping during the mission rather than on its results screen.

b.t: TrueAchievements and Insider Gaming print only the completion wording.

disputes.call: Unmissable either way; the during-mission timing only matters if you are watching for the pop.

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Finish Child's Play, a Chapter 4 story mission. Unmissable: play it in chapter order with a boundary save kept aside.

steps.t: Reach Child's Play in Chapter 4's mission order.
Keep your Chapter 4 start save untouched in its own slot before beginning.
Play the mission's objectives in order to the final cutscene.
Stay in the area until the completion banner and trophy register.
Continue into Headliners and VCIA Takedown, Chapter 4's other trophy missions.
Save once all three Chapter 4 mission trophies show in your list.
There is no mission replay, so the chapter-boundary save is your only way back if a trigger misbehaves.

a.t: GTA Zone attributes the named mission trophies to their chapters explicitly, filing Child's Play in Chapter 4.

b.t: GameMapa's story table strips mission names and keeps only chapter numbers, so its Chapter 4 grouping has to be taken on trust.

disputes.call: Chapter 4, as GTABase's full guide and GTA Zone agree - the mission order in this tracker follows them.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Finish Headliners, a Chapter 4 story mission. Unmissable in chapter order; its all-caps name is printed exactly as PlayStation publishes it.

steps.t: Reach Headliners in Chapter 4's mission order, after Child's Play.
Save before starting, with armor topped up at Ammu-Nation.
Play the mission through its final objective and cutscene.
Wait for the completion banner before fast-travelling away.
Confirm DWNFALL in the trophy list - the name is styled in capitals on the platform list.
Save and continue to VCIA Takedown.
With no mission replay available, the boundary save is the only recovery if anything stalls mid-mission.

a.t: The platform databases print the name in full capitals: DWNFALL.

b.t: Press Start's list prints the same capitals, but several roadmap summaries shorten the mission to a Chapter 4 bullet with no name at all.

disputes.call: Full capitals, as published - name matching in this tracker is case-insensitive, but we print what PlayStation prints.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Finish VCIA Takedown, the Chapter 4 airport mission. It doubles as your first guided tour of Vice City International Airport - remember the E3/E4 gates for Catch Me If You Can later.

steps.t: Reach VCIA Takedown in Chapter 4's mission order.
Save before starting and note the airport layout as the mission moves through it.
Play the takedown's objectives in order to the closing cutscene.
Mark gates E3 and E4 on your mental map - a docked jet there is the Catch Me If You Can target later.
Let the trophy register as the mission closes; PowerPyx times it during the mission.
Save after, with Chapter 4's mission set complete.
Keep the boundary save untouched until this pops - there is no replay to fall back on.

a.t: PowerPyx times Hi-Jacked during VCIA Takedown itself.

b.t: The platform lists print only Complete VCIA Takedown.

disputes.call: Same call as the other mission trophies: unmissable, timed mid-mission by the one guide that watched for it.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Finish Operation Savage Glory, Chapter 5's named mission and the last story trophy before the finale Gold. Play it, then write your untouched pre-finale save.

steps.t: Enter Chapter 5 after Starting From Zero closes Chapter 4.
Reach Operation Savage Glory in the chapter's mission order.
Save before starting; stock armor, ammo and Adrenaline.
Play the operation through its final objective and cutscene.
Let the trophy land - PowerPyx times it during the mission.
Write the untouched manual save you will keep from just before the final mission.
Confirm Snow Storm in your list before starting the finale.
If a trigger stalls mid-operation, reload the chapter-boundary save - missions cannot be replayed.

a.t: GTABase and GTA Zone both file Operation Savage Glory in Chapter 5, making it the finale's immediate predecessor.

b.t: GameMapa's spoiler-safe story table replaces mission names with chapter numbers, so its Chapter 5 row cannot be checked by name.

disputes.call: Chapter 5 - two named sources agree, and the five-chapter structure needs a named mission there.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: The Gold that eats the run: finish the in-game 100% checklist under Progress > Stats after the story. The thresholds are lenient - roughly 60% of true completion - but robberies, underwater discoveries, shooting ranges, drone races and Bret's decks must be done in full, and everything you did before the credits already counts.

steps.t: Finish the story, then open Progress > Stats > 100% Completion and screenshot the checklist for reference.
Confirm your pre-story work already counts - the checklist credits progress made before it was visible.
Rob every robbery on the list: all 39 Gang Operations across the nine gangs.
Clear every Bank Job and Payday Loan Job on the checklist - KeenGamer counts 22 bank jobs and 7 payday jobs.
Rob all 8 bank vaults, not just the 5 Maximum Withdrawal needs.
Finish the Smash 'N' Grab (34 of 35) and Stick Up (50 of 91) quotas on the checklist inside the all-robberies sweep.
Fence the money lines: $100,000 of narcotics, $100,000 of jewelry and $200,000 of vehicles, alongside the $250,000 of marked bills.
Complete all 33 underwater discoveries - one of the few lines with no partial credit.
Earn gold in all 42 Shooting Range challenges and win all 42 Top Fun drone races, not just one per location.
Clear all 15 of Bret's Target Decks for the hunting line.
Complete 300 stunts across jumps, under-bridge flights, knife flights and base jumps - 50 past the trophy.
Complete 70 of the 80 Challenges, skipping the 10 hardest.
Finish 15 of the 18 Collectible Card sets and scan 100 WAiNK locations.
Scan 200 of the 277 base vehicle models with WAiNK - keep scanning traffic as you travel.
Study 100 of the 255 animal species through binoculars; studying is enough, no kills needed.
Discover 50 of the 66 standard-issue weapons.
Log the collectible quotas: 100 of 125 Cocaine Flamingos, 30 of 34 magazines, 5 of 7 Kenton treasure sets, 15 of 18 meditations, 2 playlists, 70 of 79 styles.
Win 30 of the 40 unique races and 10 of the 13 race-challenge golds.
Beat 5 of 7 pool opponents, clear 2 of 3 mini-golf locations, sink 90 of 100 basketball hoops and play all 4 video games.
Complete 100 optional missions - purple icons and black icons with pink letters; Moses and Randy deliveries count.
Re-open the checklist after every session and attack the line with the fewest remaining items first.
Watch the final line complete and let the Gold pop - then confirm Vice Got a Price! follows if this was your last trophy.
Study animals through binoculars as you explore - dog and cat breeds count as separate species on the checklist.
Learn the map's icon key early: purple icons are optional missions, pink with black letters are main missions.

a.t: PowerPyx puts the checklist at roughly 60% of true completion, with most side quests not required and collectibles only partially required; EGamers repeats the figure.

b.t: Push Square tells players they must see and do almost everything in the game.

disputes.call: Lenient. The published line-by-line quotas (200 of 277 vehicles, 100 of 255 animals, 70 of 80 challenges) are nowhere near everything - Push Square's line is about feel, not the checklist.

disputes.topic: How long the cleanup step takes

a.t: PowerPyx and GTABase budget about 10 hours for the Strangers & Freaks and cleanup step.

b.t: KeenGamer budgets 10-20 hours for the same step.

disputes.call: Ten hours if you folded strands into the story as this roadmap does; twenty if you left them all to the end.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Complete any 250 of the 397 stunts: 130 stunt jumps, 202 under-bridge flights, 40 knife flights and 25 base jumps. Under-bridge flights are the fastest bulk; keep going to 300 afterwards because A Long Road wants them.

steps.t: Open Progress > Activities > Stunts to see the four categories and your per-category counts.
Open the map's Exploration > Stunt Spots view to list the stunts you have found by name.
Start with under-bridge flights: take a plane or helicopter and clear the 202 bridge gaps, the largest and fastest pool.
Work stunt jumps next - 130 ramps, bridges and construction sites, many marked as you explore.
Add knife flights: tilt a plane 90 degrees and slip the 40 gaps between Vice City's tall buildings.
Finish base jumps: leap from the 25 peaks and towers, drop the checkpoints and land on the target.
Press R3 on a category in the Progress menu to break your count down by region and hunt the gaps.
Ignore the separate stunt challenges on map icons - they are not required for this trophy.
Mix categories freely; any 250 of the 397 count, so never grind a category you hate.
Use a fast bike for jump clusters and a helicopter to hop between bridge lines in one flight.
Check the counter after each session - the trophy pops at 250 exactly.
Keep going to 300 stunts once the trophy lands; A Long Road's checklist demands them.
Save after each stunt session so a crash never costs you a route.

a.t: GTABase and EGamers both call under-bridge flights the quickest kind to farm.

b.t: games.gg advises picking whichever categories you find easiest instead of finishing one category completely.

disputes.call: Both, in order: bridges first for bulk, then whichever category your counter says is closest.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each of the nine activity types once: fishing, hunting, golf, a shooting range, pool, basketball, a video game, a race win and a stunt. Most fall out of other trophies - sweep the stragglers in one afternoon.

steps.t: Fish once: take a boat out and land any fish - Cal's Chapter 1 chain starts this naturally.
Hunt once: join Bret's first Target Deck outing after Coffee Break in Chapter 2.
Play one round of golf at a course on the map's Activities layer.
Enter any Shooting Range challenge - a bronze attempt counts as trying the type.
Play one game of pool against any opponent.
Sink one basket at a basketball court - one made hoop registers the type.
Complete one arcade game - Tenebrae Lux on the home TV is the fastest.
Win one race: a car race, a race challenge or a Top Fun drone race all register the type.
Complete one stunt of any kind - a single stunt jump is enough.
Check Progress after each new type; the trophy pops when the ninth type registers.
If one type will not register, repeat it at a different location - location discovery gates some activities.
Leave this trophy late: most types fall out of other trophies, then sweep whatever is missing.

disputes.topic: What counts as the race type

a.t: GTABase's list of the nine types says simply: win a race.

b.t: PowerPyx spells it out as winning a car race, a race challenge or a Top Fun drone race.

disputes.call: Any of the three race forms, won - a drone win at a Top Fun location is the cheapest way to tick it.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Gold-medal all 42 Shooting Range challenges. Ranges also raise your Focus, which feeds Gunslinger, so clear these before the combat grind. Locked challenges open as you fulfil the conditions shown on the map.

steps.t: Open the map's Activities > Shooting Ranges layer to list every range you have discovered.
Start at the range nearest your story progress and play each challenge once to learn its gold score.
Replay any challenge that missed gold immediately, while the target pattern is fresh.
Work the three difficulty tiers of a challenge in order - later tiers unlock from earlier medals.
Check locked challenges on the map and fulfil their stated unlock conditions before moving on.
Use the range sessions to raise your Focus stat - range time feeds the Gunslinger trophy.
Track your golds under Progress > Activities > Shooting Ranges after each range.
Sweep ranges region by region so no single range hides unfinished challenges.
Bring a fully upgraded weapon set from Ammu-Nation for the hardest accuracy challenges.
Revisit any range whose challenges expanded after story progress - new tiers appear over time.
Confirm the count reads 42 gold medals in the Progress menu.
Let the Silver pop on the 42nd gold.
Save - these golds are also a full line of the A Long Road checklist.
There is no partial credit for silver - every one of the 42 must be gold.

a.t: GTABase, PowerPyx, GTA Zone and GameMapa all spread the 42 challenges across 12 shooting ranges.

b.t: Push Square names only two range locations (Rodgers Ranch in Port Gellhorn and Griffin in Balsero) with three difficulty tiers each, and OutputLag likewise says two ranges hold the 42 golds between them.

disputes.call: Twelve ranges. Four independent guides give the same structure, and Push Square's two named ranges read as the two it had visited - either way, gold in all 42 challenges is the requirement.

disputes.topic: Do the challenges gate each other?

a.t: Push Square warns some challenges are locked until you fulfil conditions viewable on the map.

b.t: The other full guides present the 42 as a flat list to work through.

disputes.call: Expect locks. If a challenge is missing, check its map entry for the condition instead of assuming a bug.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win one drone race at each of the 14 Top Fun locations. Some locations charge an entry fee, so carry cash. A Long Road later wants all 42 races won, so learn the tracks properly the first time.

steps.t: Open the map's Activities > Drones > Top Fun Drones layer to see discovered locations.
Travel to the first location and pay its entry fee if it charges one.
Win the location's opening race - one win per location is all the trophy asks.
Note the track layout as you win; you will return for all 42 races on the 100% checklist.
Move location to location, ticking each off in Progress as its win registers.
Discover missing locations by exploring with the drone layer open - undiscovered spots do not show.
Retry a lost race immediately; the entry fee is small against the travel time.
Use the same route discipline as car races: brake before the checkpoint clusters, not inside them.
Confirm 14 of 14 locations show a win.
Let the trophy pop on the final location's win.
Stay for the location's remaining races if you are chasing A Long Road - 42 wins in total.
Finish each location fully while you are there - the checklist's 42 races work out to three per location.

a.t: GTABase, PowerPyx and the platform lists call them drone races, won against the field.

b.t: KeenGamer's checklist calls the same 42 events Drone Time Trials.

disputes.call: Same events, two names. Win at each of the 14 locations for the trophy; clear all 42 for the checklist.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races out of the 40 on the map - repeating one race 20 times does nothing. Hire cars where offered, or bring your own and raise its Rating at a Mod Shop.

steps.t: Open the map's Activities > Racing layer and count the race locations you have discovered.
Pick the shortest race first and win it to learn the format and the payout.
At each new location, hire the offered car if your own car's Rating is below the field's.
Improve your own car's Rating with Mod Shop upgrades if you plan to race it across the map.
Win each race once and move on - only first wins at new races advance the counter.
Track wins under Progress; the counter only moves on different races.
Explore to reveal undiscovered race locations if your discovered list runs dry before 20.
Re-run a lost race straight away while the corners are fresh.
Confirm the counter reads 20 different races won.
Keep racing to 30 unique wins afterwards - the 100% checklist asks for them.
The same unique-race wins also serve Master of None's race type - one grind, two trophies.

a.t: The trophy needs 20 different races won, of the 40 that exist.

b.t: KeenGamer's 100% table asks for 30 of the 40 unique races won, plus 10 of 13 race-challenge golds.

disputes.call: Both numbers are real: 20 pops the trophy, 30 feeds A Long Road. Do not stop at 20 if you are on a Platinum run.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal at his own game. You meet him in the Chapter 1 mission Feng Shui; work his fishing quests as they arrive by text, then win the challenge he sets you.

steps.t: Play the Chapter 1 mission Feng Shui, where Cal is introduced.
Watch for Cal's text and the purple icon marking his fishing spot.
Travel to the marked spot and speak to Cal to open his fishing quest chain.
Complete his fishing quests in order, learning the casting and reeling timing as you go.
Take a boat with a fishing rod - hijack one near the spot if you do not own one.
Fish the marked area until the target catch is in the boat.
Accept Cal's head-to-head challenge when he offers it.
Fish the challenge cleanly: no snapped lines, no dropped catches.
Beat his total and let the trophy pop as the challenge closes.
Save - the fishing type is now ticked for Master of None as well.

disputes.topic: A challenge match or a catch request?

a.t: GTABase frames a quest chain that ends in beating Cal in a fishing challenge, matching the official description.

b.t: Push Square describes a request: catch a Parrotfish over 2kg in the marked area, with a boat and rod borrowed nearby.

disputes.call: Do both readings justice: work his quests, and if a marked-area catch is what he asks for, land the 2kg Parrotfish - the chain ends at the same trophy.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Complete any one of the four video games: Tenebrae Lux, Street Trash III and Time Jackers Rewind on the TV at home, or Bang For Your Buck on arcade cabinets. The home TV is the fastest route.

steps.t: Go home and turn on the TV to find the three home games: Tenebrae Lux, Street Trash III and Time Jackers Rewind.
Pick Tenebrae Lux and play it from the start.
Play to the game's completion screen - quitting mid-game does not count.
Alternatively, find a Bang For Your Buck cabinet in an arcade and complete that instead.
Let the trophy pop as the game completes.
Note the video-game type is now ticked for Master of None.
For the 100% checklist, play all four games eventually - it asks for every one.
Do this in Chapter 1 downtime; OutputLag's checklist files it as a Chapter 1 task.
Save afterwards.

a.t: GTABase splits the four games by machine: three on the home TV, Bang For Your Buck on cabinets.

b.t: OutputLag says any of the four in-game games counts, with no machine distinction.

disputes.call: Any of the four - the home TV games are simply the fastest to reach.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Finish Andy's five-quest strand as Lucia. It starts in Chapter 3 when Andy reaches out with an address in Belville, and ends with the quest Puff Puff Pass. Start it when it unlocks - one source warns stranger chains have story-linked windows.

steps.t: Play as Lucia in Chapter 3 and watch for Andy's first contact with an address in Belville.
Travel to the Belville address and meet Andy in person to open the strand.
Complete his first quest, Climbing the Cellerichain.
Complete Pay the Cellerica Fee when it is offered.
Complete the third quest, Peach!.
Complete Read the Label, the fourth quest in the chain.
Start each new quest as soon as it appears rather than banking them for cleanup.
Complete the finale, Puff Puff Pass.
Let the trophy pop as the finale closes.
Confirm the strand in Progress; Andy's chain does not count toward Strangers & Freaks.
Save - the strand stays available after the story if you are already past Chapter 3.

disputes.topic: Does Andy call or text first?

a.t: PowerPyx says Andy calls Lucia first, then texts his home address in Belville.

b.t: GTABase says Andy texts Lucia the address directly.

disputes.call: Watch for both from Chapter 3 as Lucia - the strand opens the same way once you reach the address.

disputes.topic: Can stranger chains be left too late?

a.t: EGamers relays a single-source warning (TechWiser) that the chains behind five hidden trophies have windows linked to story progress.

b.t: OutputLag and GTABase both say the side-story finales stay available after the credits.

disputes.call: Start chains when they unlock. It costs nothing, and it makes the window question irrelevant.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Recover treasure from all seven of Kenton's shipwrecks. He starts in Chapter 1 at Key Lento (green KR icon), vanishes after the chapter, and returns by text in Chapter 2-3 - calling Brian as Jason coaxes the text out sooner.

steps.t: Meet Kenton in Chapter 1 at Key Lento - look for the green KR icon after Island Dreams.
Take his first wreck job and swim the site, following the purple chest markers.
Use the metal detector to pin each chest before you dive for it.
Work the wrecks in sets as he assigns them, checking Progress > Collections > Kenton's Treasures.
Finish every Chapter 1 wreck before the chapter ends - Kenton goes quiet afterwards.
In Chapter 2, call Brian as Jason; Kenton texts Jason shortly after and the strand resumes.
Complete the remaining wrecks as their markers appear around the Keys.
Track the strand under Progress > Characters > Kenton Rees if a marker goes missing.
Finish the seventh wreck's treasure set.
Play his final mission - Push Square names it Maritime Disputes.
Let the trophy pop as the finale closes.
Save; five of his seven treasure sets also feed the 100% checklist.
Combine wreck trips with fog-clearing flights - the Keys shallows serve The Goodtime State too.

a.t: Push Square names Kenton's final mission Maritime Disputes.

b.t: GTABase and PowerPyx describe the strand in full but never name its finale.

disputes.call: We use Push Square's name, flagged as single-source - the strand and its seven wrecks are agreed by all three.

a.t: PowerPyx gives a trigger: call Brian as Jason in Chapter 2 and Kenton texts shortly after.

b.t: GTABase says only that he texts Jason later, in Chapter 2-3, with no trigger named.

disputes.call: Use the call trick - worst case, it costs a phone call.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Finish Billy's five jobs at the Thrillbilly Mudclub in Kelly County, starting after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break. The finale is Hometown Heroes, and the strand stays open after the story.

steps.t: Complete the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break to open Billy's strand.
Travel to the Thrillbilly Mudclub in Kelly County and meet Billy.
Complete his first job, Thrillbillies.
Complete Twist Wrist Smash Grab.
Complete Mall Rats.
Complete The Impaler.
Take each new job as it is offered rather than leaving the strand idle.
Complete the finale, Hometown Heroes.
Let the trophy pop as the finale closes.
Note Billy's strand does not count toward Strangers & Freaks.
Save - GTA Zone confirms the jobs stay open after the story.

disputes.topic: Safe to leave, or start at once?

a.t: GTA Zone states Billy's five jobs stay open after the story, and GTABase agrees the strand is completable post-story.

b.t: The single-source window warning relayed by EGamers covers the stranger chains behind the hidden trophies, Billy's included.

disputes.call: Start it in Chapter 2 anyway. Post-story availability is agreed; starting early only removes the doubt.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete eight qualifying stranger strands. Only some strands count: Kirk, Kyle, Yago and Pilot Pete are confirmed, while the named characters with their own trophies do not advance this counter. Watch the trophy's own progress counter after every strand - and do Yago's timed Chapter 3 race the moment it appears.

steps.t: Understand the rule first: only some strands count, and the trophy's progress counter is the only reliable scoreboard.
Complete Kirk's strand - 3 quests - and check the counter moves.
Complete Kyle's strand - 3 quests - and check the counter again.
Complete Yago's strand - 4 quests, including his street races.
The moment Yago's timed Chapter 3 race (Race Against Yago, hourglass icon) appears, save and run it at once - it is time-sensitive.
Complete Pilot Pete's strand - 5 quests.
Do not count Andy, Billy, Tyrone, Moses, Yasmani or Eddie toward the eight - their strands carry their own trophies or none.
Hunt the remaining qualifying strands among the strangers without their own trophies; more exist than the confirmed four.
After each finished strand, open the trophy list and confirm the counter rose before moving on.
Keep strands moving during the story rather than leaving all eight to cleanup.
Reach eight counted strands and let the Silver pop.
Remember this trophy is not part of the 100% checklist - it is its own grind.
Save with the counter at 8 of 8.
The six character strands with their own trophies do not feed this counter - do them for those trophies instead.

disputes.topic: Which strands count - three different answers

a.t: PowerPyx confirms Kirk, Kyle, Yago and Pilot Pete, excludes Moses, Tyrone, Yasmani, Andy, Billy and Eddie, and leaves the rest undiscovered; GTABase's list matches.

b.t: OutputLag and games.gg exclude only Andy, Billy and Tyrone, reasoning they have their own trophies - but Kenton and Randy have their own trophies too and are excluded by nobody. GTA Zone excludes Moses, Tyrone, Yasmani, Andy and Billy.

disputes.call: Follow the named four and the in-game counter. The own-trophy rule is inconsistent across sources, so never assume a strand counted - verify on the counter.

a.t: OutputLag singles out Race Against Yago in Chapter 3 as time-sensitive and tells you to run it the moment it appears.

b.t: No other guide flags any Strangers & Freaks element as losable, and the trophy itself is never called missable.

disputes.call: Treat the race as at-risk, not the trophy: run it on sight and the question never matters.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Deliver all 16 cars on Randy's Wish List to his west Vice City garage (RK icon). The list opens after the Chapter 3 mission Clonin' Keys, Makin' GS; list cars frequent the hotel driveways of east Vice City, and their condition sets your pay.

steps.t: Complete Clonin' Keys, Makin' GS in Chapter 3 - the mission itself has you deliver a Zorrusso, the list's first car.
Open Map > Robberies > Randy's Wish List and read the 16 named cars.

Learn the list: Granforma Zorrusso, Pegassi Vitello, Pegassi Infernus, Buckingham Windsor Drop, Pegassi Toros, Pegassi Tempesta, Ascot Paragon, Ocelot Jagular, Buckingham Jubilee, Grotti Itali RSX, Pfister Growler, Bravado Gauntlet Hellfire, Piccia Furia, Benefactor Dubsta, Bravado Banshee, Gallivanter Baller ST-D.
Hold Up to open WAiNK and scan cars as you travel - the app flags Wish List cars.
Hunt the hotel driveways of Vice Beach and Ocean Beach in east Vice City, where list cars appear most.
Steal each list car cleanly and drive it gently - damage lowers the payout.
Deliver the car to Randy's garage in west Vice City, marked with the RK icon.
Repeat until the Wish List counter reads 16 of 16.
Complete Randy's final mission once the list is done.
Let the trophy pop as the finale closes.
Note the deliveries also count as optional missions toward the 100% checklist's 100.
Save with the garage deliveries complete.
If a car will not spawn, change district and return - spawns rotate with traffic.
Wish List cars are high-end models - delivering them also grows your vehicle discoveries for Whip It Good.

disputes.topic: How to trigger a WAiNK scan

a.t: GTABase's vehicle guide says hold Up on the D-pad, then press R1/RB to scan.

b.t: PowerPyx's Randy passage and Push Square's WAiNK section describe opening the app by holding Up, with no second button named.

disputes.call: Hold Up to raise the phone; if the scan does not fire, add R1/RB. Both descriptions agree on Up as the opener.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Finish Tyrone's Jason-only strand: after the Chapter 3 mission Here, Kitty Kitty, destroy his rivals' synthetic drug labs (purple markers) around Vice City until the finale unlocks. Play it as Jason - Lucia never gets this strand.

steps.t: Switch to Jason - this strand is Jason-only.
Complete the Chapter 3 mission Here, Kitty Kitty to mark Tyrone's strand.
Meet Tyrone and take the first lab job, Take Out Kitty Litter.
Travel to a purple-marked lab and destroy it, clearing its defenders first.
Repeat lab destructions around Vice City as new markers appear.
Watch for the follow-up quest to unlock once enough labs are down.
Start the finale as soon as it is offered - strands are best not left idle.
Complete the finale and shut the operation down for good.
Let the trophy pop as the finale closes.
Note Tyrone's strand does not count toward Strangers & Freaks.
Save with the labs cleared.

a.t: PowerPyx names the trophy-unlocking quest Spin On This (Shut Down the Labs).

b.t: GTABase calls the final job Shut Down the Labs, and GTAScoop files the trophy under a finale named Spin On This.

disputes.call: Same quest, two name forms: the quest is Spin On This, subtitled Shut Down the Labs. Look for either.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at all 18 spots - the run's only possibly-missable trophy. The Chapter 1 balcony meditation at Jason's house raises the counter but is not marked as a spot, and no source confirms whether the trophy needs it: do it anyway, then meditate with both characters at every spot (each counts), saving the last spot until both are playable.

steps.t: In Chapter 1, the morning after Down to Earth, find Lucia in the kitchen at Jason's house.
Follow her to the balcony by the training equipment when she says she is going to meditate.
Look at her and select Accept to complete the balcony meditation.
Confirm the Progress counter rose by 1 - the balcony counts toward the total without being a marked spot.
Keep a Chapter 1 save with the meditation done until this trophy pops, much later.
From Chapter 2, open Touch Pad > Exploration > Meditate Around Leonida to list discovered spots.
Travel to each purple meditation icon as you explore; spots show when you are close.
Meditate at each spot with Jason, then switch and meditate again with Lucia - a spot done by both counts twice.
Stay until the final zen animation finishes - Push Square warns the spot does not count before it plays.
Track progress under Progress > Collections > Exploration > Meditations.
Leave the final spot until after Coffee Break in Chapter 2, when both characters are playable together - it needs both.
Work the spots region by region alongside stunt and WAiNK routes to avoid backtracking.
If your count stalls at 17, re-check the balcony: it is the one spot with no map marker.
Reach 18 on the counter and let the trophy pop.
Remember the checklist only asks 15 of 18 - a missed balcony can never cost you A Long Road.
Save with the trophy earned and the Chapter 1 slot finally free to rotate.
Do the Chapter 1 balcony meditation even before you know whether it counts - the main roadmaps order it first.

a.t: PowerPyx's author did the balcony meditation and earned the trophy, and every roadmap orders you to do it - but PowerPyx itself says it is unclear whether the trophy needs it, since it is not marked as a Meditation Spot.

b.t: GTABase, KeenGamer and EGamers all file the requirement as unconfirmed.

disputes.call: Unconfirmed - and irrelevant if you follow this roadmap: do it in Chapter 1 and the question never decides your Platinum.

a.t: GTABase counts 18 spots, with both characters meditating at one spot counting as two toward the total.

b.t: GTA Zone describes 18 spots in 10 locations with Jason and Lucia - the same doubling, framed by location - while the 100% checklist asks for only 15, per the Press Start list EGamers quotes.

disputes.call: Eighteen on the trophy counter, fifteen on the checklist. Meditate as both characters everywhere and both numbers take care of themselves.

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt for Bret Vogel through his Target Decks. Bret texts Jason after Coffee Break in Chapter 2 - the strand is Jason-only - and his first quest, Veteran Hunted in Lummox County, hands you the Killtelligence SM-69 rifle. Which unique animal triggers the trophy is still unconfirmed, so work the decks in order.

steps.t: Complete Coffee Break in Chapter 2 and watch for Bret's text - it comes to Jason only.
Switch to Jason; Lucia never receives this strand.
Start the first quest, Veteran Hunted, in Lummox County.
Collect the unique rifle Bret provides, the Killtelligence SM-69, from an Ammu-Nation weapon locker.
Open Map > Activities > Target Deck to see the deck's target and its purple icon.
Travel to the marked hunting ground and track the deck's animal.
Take the animal with one clean shot - a pristine carcass pays more, though it is not required.
Bring the carcass back as Jason to close the deck.
Work the decks in order; the trophy's trigger animal is one of the unique hunts among them.
Keep clearing decks past the trophy - all 15 are a full line of the 100% checklist.
Let the trophy pop when the unique animal is delivered.
Save with the strand underway or complete.
Decks are hunting, so the first completed deck also ticks Master of None's hunting type.

disputes.topic: Which animal, and does the kill need to be clean?

a.t: Every full guide agrees the triggering animal is unconfirmed; GTABase adds that a clean one-shot kill pays more but is not required.

b.t: OutputLag advises a clean head or heart shot to keep the carcass pristine, reading closer to a requirement.

disputes.call: Hunt clean anyway - it pays more on every reading - and clear decks in order so the unconfirmed trigger is met whichever animal it is.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Complete any 3 of the 18 Collectible Card sets. Track set progress under Progress > Collections, and keep collecting afterwards: the 100% checklist wants 15 completed sets.

steps.t: Open Progress > Collections > Collectible Cards to see the 18 sets and your progress in each.
Pick the set closest to completion and make it your first target.
Collect cards as you travel - check new interiors, rooftops and robbery locations as you clear them.
Return to a set's missing-card locations with the Progress screen open to confirm each pickup registers.
Complete the first full set; note that collected cards still count even if you later sell them, per Push Square.
Complete a second set the same way, favouring sets your routes already cross.
Complete the third set and let the Silver pop.
Keep the habit: 15 completed sets are required for A Long Road, so never leave a card behind.
Use downtime between robberies to sweep a set's home district completely.
Save with three sets banked.

a.t: Push Square says collected cards can be sold at Pawn Shops and still contribute toward your progress.

b.t: No other guide mentions selling cards at all - GTABase tracks them purely as collection progress.

disputes.call: Hold completed sets until the trophy pops; after that, Push Square's note makes selling safe - and 15 sets for the checklist argues for keeping them anyway.

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: Scan 100 locations with the WAiNK app: hold Up to raise the phone, then scan landmarks (31), curiosities (35), sculptures (23) and No Flusher tags until the counter reaches 100. Scan as you travel from Chapter 1 on - this is a habit trophy, not a cleanup trophy.

steps.t: Hold Up on the D-pad to open the WAiNK app on your phone.
Aim at a scannable landmark and press R1/RB to scan it, per GTABase's control notes.
Scan your first landmark and confirm the counter moves under Progress > Collections > WAiNK Locations.
Prioritise the 31 landmarks - they are the largest signed pool and sit on main routes.
Add the 35 curiosities as their icons appear in towns and the Keys.
Scan the 23 sculptures in Vice City's public spaces.
Photograph No Flusher tags whenever you spot one to top the counter up.
Make scanning a travel habit: every new district, stop and sweep before moving on.
Combine scan stops with vehicle scanning for Whip It Good on the same journeys.
If a location will not scan, close the distance and re-aim - scans are range-limited.
Check the counter weekly; more than 100 scannable spots exist, so no single miss matters.
Reach 100 scans and let the Silver pop.
Save - the same 100 scans satisfy the checklist's WAiNK line in full.
Run landmark scans and vehicle scans in the same stops - both apps reward the same exploring.

a.t: GTABase documents a two-step input: hold Up, then press R1/RB to scan.

b.t: Push Square and OutputLag describe WAiNK as opened by holding Up, without naming a scan button.

disputes.call: Hold Up, then R1/RB if the scan does not fire on its own - the two accounts differ in detail, not in substance.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Complete 50 of the 80 in-game Challenges listed under Progress > Challenges. Many finish on their own as you play; target the easy remainders and save the hardest 10 for never - the checklist only asks 70.

steps.t: Open Progress > Challenges and read all 80 requirements before grinding anything.
Note which challenges are already progressing from normal play - robberies, driving and combat feed many.
Play normally through the story and re-check the list; a base of challenges completes itself.
Pick off the shortest remaining challenges one at a time - single-action and low-count ones first.
Batch challenges by location so one trip closes several.
Use the robbery grind to feed crime-linked challenges while you work Pest Control and the vaults.
Skip any challenge that stalls you; you may leave 30 unfinished for this trophy.
Confirm the counter reads 50 and let the trophy pop.
Continue to 70 of 80 afterwards for A Long Road, still skipping the 10 hardest.
Save with the challenge list reviewed.
Screenshot the challenge list in Progress so you can plan routes between sessions.

a.t: PowerPyx frames the skip allowance around the hardest challenges - leave the 10 most difficult of the 80.

b.t: KeenGamer frames the same allowance as the 10 most difficult or time-consuming.

disputes.call: Skip by your own clock: a challenge that is merely long is worth less than one that is hard - either framing leaves you 70 reachable.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: With your partner beside you, earn a 4-star Wanted Level and escape until you are fully out of the red heat zone - leaving the flashing search area alone is not enough. Bank vault robberies hand you 4 stars automatically, and the rail tunnel north of Ambrosia in Kelly County is the classic escape.

steps.t: Wait until after Coffee Break in Chapter 2, when partner play is fully open.
Call your partner in: hold Right on the D-pad and press Triangle/Y.
Confirm your partner is with you before starting anything - the trophy needs you together.
Rob a bank vault after Chapter 4's That's Where The Money Is... - vaults guarantee 4 stars with your partner along.
Alternatively, build 4 stars manually with public robberies until the fourth star fills.
Break line of sight and head for the rail tunnel north of Ambrosia in Kelly County.
Ride the tunnel until the helicopter loses you and ground units stop following the tracks.
Keep going until you are completely out of the red heat zone - the flashing search circle alone does not count.
If the escape stalls, swap vehicles mid-flight and shoot down the helicopter to buy distance.
Let the trophy pop once the heat zone clears with your partner still with you.
Save - the same escape pattern serves A Classic Blitz Play and every vault run.
If your partner will not come, finish a strand beat and call again - the call-in only works in free roam.

a.t: PowerPyx says this pops automatically during That's Where The Money Is... vault robberies, since they always bring 4 stars with your partner hauling bags.

b.t: GTABase presents it as a manual escape to arrange yourself, tunnel and all.

disputes.call: Both: if it has not popped by your first vault escape, arrange it manually in the Ambrosia tunnel. Either way the heat-zone exit is the trigger.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: With your partner, rob three shops in a row while the police are actively chasing you - the red-and-blue flashing pursuit must never drop between shops; sitting in the red heat zone without stars breaks the chain. The three jewelry stores of north Vice City sit close enough to run as one chain, and the trophy can land ~30 seconds after the third shop.

steps.t: Call your partner in and confirm they are with you before the first shop.
Bring armor, healing items and sticky bombs for safes and fast exits.
Head to north Vice City, where three jewelry stores sit close together after Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs in Chapter 3.
Enter the first store and rob it - take the items and break the back-room safe if time allows.
Wait for the police to arrive and the pursuit to be actively flashing before you leave - leaving too early can force a fourth shop.
Drive straight to the second store with the pursuit live and rob it the same way.
Never let the stars fade to the red heat zone alone - that breaks the back-to-back chain.
Rob the third store without the Wanted Level dropping at any point.
Leave the third shop and give the trophy its moment - it can take about 30 seconds to pop.
Only if nothing lands after a full minute, rob a fourth shop to close the chain.
Escape the heat afterwards at your leisure - the trophy is already earned.
Save with the chain complete.
Jewelry stores double as Sneakthief targets - learn their back rooms during these robberies.

disputes.topic: If the third shop does not pop it

a.t: OutputLag and GameMapa both warn the unlock is delayed by roughly 30 seconds after leaving the final shop - wait before doing anything else.

b.t: GTABase's advice, repeated by EGamers, is to rob a fourth shop if the trophy does not pop after the third.

disputes.call: Wait the 30 seconds first. A fourth robbery restarts your exposure for nothing if the pop was simply late.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover 100 different vehicles. A WAiNK scan counts - you never need to drive them - so scan traffic on busy roads as you travel. The checklist later wants 200 of the 277 base models, so keep the habit for the whole run.

steps.t: Open WAiNK with Up and scan the first unfamiliar car you see to register it.
Confirm the discovery under Progress > Vehicles after a few scans.
Stand on a busy Vice City road and scan traffic as it passes - the fastest discovery rate in the game.
Scan parked cars in hotel driveways and rich districts, where rare models gather.
Scan boats, bikes, helicopters and planes too - 557 vehicles exist at launch across all classes.
Get inside any vehicle that refuses to scan; entering it also discovers it.
Make scanning reflexive on every journey from Chapter 1 onward.
Check the counter after each session - 100 different vehicles is the line.
Let the trophy pop at 100.
Keep scanning to 200 base models for A Long Road - half the work is already done.
Scan every car Randy wants while you hunt the Wish List - the strand doubles your discovery rate.

a.t: GTABase and EGamers are explicit: a WAiNK scan discovers the vehicle, no driving needed.

b.t: Push Square says you discover a vehicle by getting inside one or by scanning one.

disputes.call: Scanning is enough - Push Square lists entering as the alternative, not the requirement.

a.t: PowerPyx counts 557 vehicles at launch across cars, bikes, boats, helicopters and planes.

b.t: The checklist-facing sources count 277 base models, of which 200 must be discovered for 100%.

disputes.call: Both: 277 base models, 557 individual vehicles. The counters that matter - 100 for the trophy, 200 for the checklist - are counted in base models.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Fill your Focus meter, then take down five enemies inside one Combat Focus (L3+R3 while aiming). Use an assault rifle against a clustered group of gang members at an illegal operation - police, soldiers and civilians do not appear to count - and pop Adrenaline to stretch the window.

steps.t: Raise your Focus first: eat, drink or wash at home, and spend time at shooting ranges, golf, pool or fishing.
Check your Focus level under Touch Pad > Jason & Lucia > Focus - higher levels last longer.
Buy an assault rifle - PowerPyx recommends the Duke 556 - and armor at Ammu-Nation.
Carry Adrenaline: hold L1 and press Triangle to use it and extend Focus.
Travel to a gang's illegal operation, where enemy thugs cluster in groups.
Position with at least five gang members in view before you trigger anything.
Aim your weapon and press L3+R3 to enter Combat Focus.
Drop five gang members before the meter drains, prioritising the closest targets.
If the count falls short, refill Focus and retry at a fresh operation - never waste the attempt on police or civilians.
Let the trophy pop on the fifth takedown inside one activation.
Save with the technique learned - it serves every robbery escape afterwards.
Clear shooting-range golds first - the ranges raise the Focus this trophy spends.

a.t: GTABase and EGamers both report that cops, soldiers and civilians do not appear to count - gang members are the reliable targets.

b.t: The official description and the platform lists say only 5 enemies, with no class restriction printed.

disputes.call: Use gang members at an illegal operation. If the description is broader, you lose nothing; if it is not, you are covered.

a.t: OutputLag adds a surprising source: each fish you land adds about 10% to the Focus meter.

b.t: GTABase and PowerPyx list eating, drinking, washing at home, ranges and headshots - no fishing.

disputes.call: Fill up at home and the range as the main guides say; if fishing tops you off too, that is a bonus, not a plan.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Steal a large passenger jet docked at a boarding bridge at VCIA - gates E3/E4 are the easy targets - back it out, take off and fly about 1 km away. Jets parked loose on the airfield do not count, and the pop is delayed until you are clear.

steps.t: Save manually before entering the airport - the police response is fast.
Travel to Vice City International Airport and make for gates E3 or E4.
Reach the docked jet: through the airfield fence to the door by the stairs next to the bridge, or on foot through the terminal.
Confirm the jet is connected to a boarding bridge - a plane parked elsewhere on the airfield does not count.
Go up to the cockpit and take control.
Reverse out toward the runway, clear of the terminal buildings.
Take off as soon as you have runway - do not wait for the police to organise.
Fly directly away from the airport; the trophy is delayed by design.
Pass roughly 1 km from the airport and let the trophy pop.
Lose the heat or bail out somewhere safe, then save.
A delayed pop is normal - stay airborne rather than landing early to check.

a.t: GTABase routes you through the airfield fence to the door by the stairs next to the boarding bridge.

b.t: PowerPyx adds that you can also enter on foot via the terminal.

disputes.call: Either route - what matters is the jet's parking, not your path to it.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: Steal a Rhino tank from Mile Zero Air Station, on the south-western island in Mariana County, and take out enemies from inside it. Save before you breach the gate - the base answers theft with force.

steps.t: Save manually before approaching Mile Zero Air Station.
Travel to the base at the south-western edge of the map in Mariana County, on Goose Key.
Enter through the main gate, or stunt-jump the fence by the south-east entrance.
Head for the tanks parked at the south end of the base.
Get into a Rhino before the garrison converges on you.
Drive and fire from inside the tank - the kills must be the tank's, made from within it.
Take out enemies until the trophy pops; it may take several kills, not one.
Keep moving - a stationary tank is a target even for this base's weapons.
Escape the base or go down fighting once the trophy lands; the pop is what matters.
Save after, with the trophy banked.

a.t: GTABase and GTA Zone both describe stealing the tank and taking out enemies from inside it.

b.t: OutputLag's account is looser: get in, drive and fire until it pops.

disputes.call: Kill from inside the tank. It satisfies both accounts, and simply joyriding may not register.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store's safe without anyone spotting you. You need the Snap Gun from Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs (Chapter 3): use it on the locked back door - kicking the door sets off the alarm - then find the safe-code note in the back room and empty the safe unseen. Richardson Jewelry & Diamonds in Vice City is the proven target.

steps.t: Complete Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs in Chapter 3 to receive the Snap Gun and open jewelry robberies.
Choose your target: Richardson Jewelry & Diamonds in Vice City is the store two guides name.
Save outside the store before you begin - a spotted attempt is a reload, not a retry.
Circle to the store's locked back door, away from the street.
Use the Snap Gun on the back door - never kick it in; kicking triggers the alarm and ends the attempt.
Enter the back room quietly and find the note carrying the safe code.
Destroy the security footage and disable the alarm panel in the back room, per PowerPyx's fuller account.
Open the safe with the code and empty it without being seen by staff or cameras.
Leave by the back door the way you came, still undetected.
Let the trophy land shortly after you leave the store.
If anyone spots you at any point, reload the save and run it again cleanly.
Save with the perfect robbery banked.
The same Snap Gun opens every jewelry store - after the trophy, the method repeats for robbery income.

disputes.topic: Two extra steps only one guide lists

a.t: PowerPyx's method adds destroying the security footage and disabling the alarm in the back room before touching the safe.

b.t: GTABase's method goes Snap Gun, code note, safe, leave - with no footage or alarm step.

disputes.call: Do the extra steps. They cost seconds, and if PowerPyx's fuller account is the real checklist, skipping them fails the run.

a.t: GTABase and OutputLag both name Richardson Jewelry & Diamonds in Vice City as a good target.

b.t: The official description allows any jewelry store robbed undetected.

disputes.call: Use Richardson's - a named, verified layout beats an unknown one.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Rob 5 of the 8 bank vaults and escape each time. Vaults open with the optional Chapter 4 mission That's Where The Money Is...: tail the security van, enter while the guard has the vault open, and haul the bags out with your partner - you cannot carry them all alone. Every vault pays up to $205,000 and brings 4 stars, so stage a fast bike and a vehicle swap.

steps.t: Take the optional Chapter 4 mission That's Where The Money Is... - wait at the cafe as it begins.
Tail the armored security van to a large bank without spooking it.
Follow the guard carrying the briefcase inside and enter the vault while he has it open.
Complete the in-mission vault robbery - this is your first of the eight, and it also feeds A Classic Blitz Play.
Bring your partner on every later vault: the cash bags are too heavy to haul alone.
Hand bags to your partner with Right on the D-pad to speed the loading.
Expect 4 stars the moment you leave a vault - plan the escape before you enter.
Escape on a fast bike staged outside, then swap vehicles to break the search.
Buy Yasmani's van tips for $10,000 to schedule later vaults - if he will not sell, finish his earlier Payday Loan jobs for him first.
Repeat vaults until five are robbed with escapes - the checklist wants all eight, so keep going afterwards.
Bank the marked bills a vault pays out; they are the fastest feed for Dime on the Dollar.
Let the Silver pop on the fifth escaped vault.
Use vault escapes with your partner to double up on Hot Together if it is still open.
Save with the vault route learned.
Five vaults at up to $205,000 each also fund the garages and the spending trophy - schedule them together.

a.t: GTABase, GamesFuze, TrueAchievements and Radio Times all grade Maximum Withdrawal Silver at 40G - the grade the official 1/2/6/46 split requires.

b.t: Push Square's guide lists it as Bronze.

disputes.call: Silver. Push Square's page would leave the list with five Silvers; the platform databases and the grade arithmetic agree on six.

a.t: PowerPyx says Yasmani sells van tips only after you have robbed 2 Payday Loans for him earlier in his quest line.

b.t: GTABase mentions the $10,000 tips with no prerequisite stated.

disputes.call: Do his Payday jobs first if the tips will not sell - it is his quest line either way.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and escape the heat zone. The reliable route is free: a bank vault robbery counts toward this trophy when you escape, and your first vault is scripted inside That's Where The Money Is.... The street method - box a truck in and blow its rear doors with a sticky bomb - also works.

steps.t: Take the Chapter 4 optional mission That's Where The Money Is... and rob its vault.
Escape fully out of the red heat zone afterwards - leaving the flashing search area is not enough.
Check your trophy list: for PowerPyx, the vault robbery unlocks this automatically.
If it has not popped, hunt a truck on the street instead: armored trucks gather near banks.
Box the truck in with your vehicle so it cannot drive off.
Blow the rear doors with a sticky bomb - sticky bombs are found in the back of Yasmani's shop after his quests.
Take the cash from the opened truck.
Escape the heat zone completely and let the trophy pop.
Save with both robbery trophies banked.
Use the same escape discipline as Hot Together: clear the red zone, not just the search circle.

disputes.topic: Does a vault really count as a truck?

a.t: PowerPyx says this unlocks automatically inside That's Where The Money Is..., treating the vault job as the armored-truck robbery.

b.t: GTABase says a bank vault robbery also counts - if you escape the heat zone.

disputes.call: It counts, with GTABase's condition: the escape completes it. If your vault escape was messy, do one street truck to be certain.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Clear the fog from the entire Leonida map. A plane over the dark patches is the fastest broom: fly grid patterns over land and the Keys until no fog remains anywhere.

steps.t: Open the map and study the fog: every dark patch is unexplored ground.
Take a plane - flying clears fog far faster than driving.
Fly a grid over Vice City's districts first, where the fog breaks into small pockets.
Sweep the mainland counties next: Kelly County, Mariana County and Lummox County.
Fly the Keys chain end to end, including Goose Key and Key Lento.
Drop low over water gaps and island edges, where thin fog slivers survive high passes.
Re-open the map after each flight and mark what is left before taking off again.
Finish the last pockets on a helicopter or boat where a plane cannot linger.
Let the trophy pop when the final patch clears.
Combine fog flights with stunt-spot discovery - bridges and peaks clear both maps at once.

a.t: GTABase and GameMapa both define the trophy as clearing the map's fog, with flying the stated method.

b.t: Press Start and Radio Times print the bare description, Explore all of Leonida, with no mechanic named - readable as visiting every area.

disputes.call: Fog. The full guides that watched the system name it directly, and a fog-free map also proves every area was visited.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob one illegal operation from each of the nine gangs - 39 operations exist, but the trophy needs only one per gang. Operations show as yellow icons; track gang coverage under Progress > Gangs, and keep going afterwards because the checklist wants all 39.

steps.t: Open Progress > Gangs and note the nine gangs and their territories.
Find your first operation - they are marked with yellow icons on the map.
Rob it thoroughly: take every key valuable before you leave, so the visit also feeds the checklist.
Escape the police and confirm the gang is marked robbed in Progress.
Move to a different gang's territory - a second operation from the same gang does not advance this trophy.
Repeat once per gang, working territory by territory across the map.
Use these robberies as Gunslinger stages: their clustered thugs are ideal Combat Focus targets.
Check the gang list after each robbery so none is robbed twice while another is missed.
Rob the ninth gang's first operation and let the trophy pop.
Keep clearing operations afterwards - all 39 are required by A Long Road.
Save with the map's gangs all touched once.
Kingpin Bowling is itself a gang operation - it counts here as well as toward Let's Go Bowling.

a.t: The trophy's wording and every guide agree: one operation from each of the nine gangs.

b.t: KeenGamer's checklist table lists Gang Operations 39 of 39 - which is the A Long Road requirement, easily misread as this trophy's.

disputes.call: Nine for the trophy, 39 for the checklist. This tracker counts the trophy; the grind continues after it pops.

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: The cocktail is at the Ocean View Rooftop Bar on Ocean Beach. PowerPyx publishes a full solution - buy an Apple Martini and drink it standing next to the bar - while most other guides still list the trigger as unconfirmed, so treat the method as the best available account rather than settled fact.

steps.t: Travel to Ocean Beach, on Vice City's eastern shore.
Find the Ocean View Rooftop Bar and go up to the rooftop.
Stand next to the bar itself, not at a table - position matters in PowerPyx's account.
Order an Apple Martini from the bar.
Drink it standing at the bar, with the ocean view in front of you.
Let the trophy pop as the drink finishes.
If nothing pops, reposition directly beside the bar and repeat with a fresh drink.
Try it in the evening if the bar will not serve earlier - the rooftop trade is a nightlife scene.
Save with the series' opening Easter egg banked.

a.t: PowerPyx publishes an exact method: Ocean View Rooftop Bar, an Apple Martini, drunk standing next to the bar. GTAScoop independently names the same bar.

b.t: GTABase, KeenGamer and EGamers all still list the exact steps as unconfirmed.

disputes.call: Follow PowerPyx's method - it is specific, cheap to test, and the bar itself is corroborated. The UNCONFIRMED badge stays until a second guide prints the drink.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: A GTA III homage with one specific car: the blue Banshee in a showroom in south Vice City. You need the Key Cloner from Chapter 3's Clonin' Keys to take it - hack the car, then drive it straight out through the showroom window and away. Other cars do not trigger it.

steps.t: Complete Clonin' Keys, Makin' GS in Chapter 3 to obtain the Key Cloner.
Travel to the vehicle showroom in south Vice City.
Find the specific blue Banshee on the showroom floor - it is the only car that counts.
Use the Key Cloner to hack the Banshee and take control of it.
Position the car facing the showroom's glass frontage.
Accelerate straight through the window in classic style.
Drive away from the showroom and clear the immediate area.
Let the trophy pop as you leave with the car.
If nothing pops, confirm you took the blue Banshee and not another showroom car, then retry.
Save - and keep the Banshee; it is also a Randy Wish List car if it appears there.

disputes.topic: One specific car or any car?

a.t: PowerPyx is exact: only the blue Banshee works, it needs the Key Cloner, and the stunt is a deliberate GTA III Banshee homage.

b.t: GTABase reads the description generally - driving a car out through a showroom window - and GTA Zone calls the window reading unconfirmed.

disputes.call: The blue Banshee. A general method that fails silently is worse than a specific one; PowerPyx's account explains why generic attempts report nothing.

trophies.name: Let's Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Rob Kingpin Bowling in Port Gellhorn - the Kolt & Associates alley is a gang operation, first marked by the Chapter 2 activity Hit Kingpin Bowling. Take all three key valuables (the luxury watch, the Gutterball Moreland 850 shotgun and the office safe's contents), then lose the police. The valuables do not all need to come from one visit.

steps.t: Wait for the Chapter 2 activity Hit Kingpin Bowling to mark the alley, or travel to Port Gellhorn directly.
Bring sticky bombs - the office safe is blown open, not picked.
Save outside before you go in; this is a robbery, with a police response.
Enter Kingpin Bowling and clear the gang members inside.
Take the luxury watch from the office - games.gg places it in the south-east office.
Take the Gutterball Moreland 850 shotgun from the table - the north-east table in games.gg's layout.
Blow the office safe in the north-east hallway with a sticky bomb and take its contents.
Confirm you hold all three key valuables; previously collected ones still count if you return on a later visit.
Escape and lose the police completely.
Let the trophy pop once the heat is gone.
Save - and note the operation returns slowly if you ever need it for the 39.
This operation also counts toward Pest Control's nine gangs - one robbery, two trophies.

a.t: GTABase and games.gg both confirm the three valuables do not need to be taken in a single visit - earlier pickups stay counted.

b.t: OutputLag's walkthrough narrates it as one clean run: all three valuables, then escape.

disputes.call: One run is tidiest, but a missed valuable is recoverable on a return visit - do not restart a run over it.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: Max out Strength for both Jason and Lucia. Buy a fitness club membership and train with your partner present - the partner trains alongside you, so both Strength bars climb together. It can only start after Coffee Break, and a home gym after the story does the same job.

steps.t: Wait until after Coffee Break in Chapter 2 - partner training only opens then.
Call your partner in and travel together to a fitness club - find them under Map > Activities.
Buy the fitness club membership.
Train on the equipment while your partner works out beside you - they train automatically, doubling the progress.
Check both Strength bars under Touch Pad > Jason & Lucia > Strength (the heart icon).
Rotate exercises and repeat sessions until Jason's Strength is full.
Keep training until Lucia's Strength is also full - both must be maxed.
After the story, the home gym can finish any remaining points without travel.
Let the trophy pop when the second character's bar fills.
Save with the partnership at full strength.

a.t: PowerPyx and GameMapa both say the inactive partner trains automatically alongside you, so one membership works both bars at once.

b.t: GTABase's account centres on training at fitness clubs with your partner along, without spelling out the automatic doubling.

disputes.call: Train together at a club. On every account it is the fastest legal route to two full bars.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: Log 500 actions that move your Criminal Profile. Robberies and fights feed it naturally, so most of the count arrives uninvited - the discipline is the ceiling, not the floor: the Irredeemable profile at the violent end is permanent and makes police shoot on sight.

steps.t: Find your Criminal Profile tier - the scale runs Professional, Hardened, Violent, Psycho, Irredeemable.
Check your current action count by clicking the trophy in the in-game trophy list, per PowerPyx.
Play the robbery grind - gang operations, vaults and jobs all feed the counter.
Let fights and escapes add their share; OutputLag expects the count to fill without a dedicated grind.
Watch your tier as it climbs and note how police behaviour changes with it.
Slow down as you approach the Psycho tier - the counter needs 500 actions, not the worst profile.
Never push into Irredeemable: it is permanent, and officers shoot on sight from then on.
If you need a top-up, use robbery work rather than civilian harm - it counts and it pays.
Reach 500 profile actions and let the trophy pop.
Save with your profile intact and your police relations survivable.
Robberies are the safe feed: they count here, toward Pest Control and toward the checklist at once.

a.t: PowerPyx says the count is viewed by clicking the trophy in the trophy list.

b.t: GTABase points to Settings > UI notifications for profile feedback.

disputes.call: Check the trophy list first for the number; the settings path governs the pop-ups, not the total.
