disputes.topic: Farm it or let it come?

a.t: PowerPyx gives a farming method - running down civilians and police - with an explicit warning about the Psycho and Irredeemable tiers it causes.

b.t: OutputLag says robberies and fights fill the 500 naturally, with no separate grind needed.

disputes.call: Natural accumulation through robbery work. The deliberate farm risks a permanent profile for a counter that fills itself.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: Second time's the charm, literally: re-rob the same Payday Loans store from the Prologue, in Little Cuba, as Lucia alone. It unlocks after Chapter 3's Credit Check; empty the three cash drawers and escape on foot - a vehicle escape fails it, and the pop is delayed until you leave the search area.

steps.t: Complete Credit Check in Chapter 3, which opens Payday Loan robberies and gives you the Dye Pack Jammer.
Switch to Lucia and go alone - a partner voids the method.
Save outside before entering, so a failed escape costs nothing.
Travel to the Prologue's Payday Loans store in Little Cuba, Vice City.
Aim at the teller to start the robbery.
Kill the security guard before he raises the alarm response.
Break through the door to the back and empty all three cash drawers.
Leave on foot - do not take a vehicle; a driven escape fails the trophy.
Run until you are fully out of the search area.
Wait for the delayed pop once the area is clear.
Save with the second robbery done right.

disputes.topic: A full published method or still unconfirmed?

a.t: PowerPyx publishes the complete method: same Prologue store, Lucia alone, three drawers, escape on foot, earliest after Credit Check.

b.t: GTABase, KeenGamer, EGamers and GTAScoop all still list the trigger as unknown or unconfirmed.

disputes.call: Run PowerPyx's method - it fits the description exactly (a second robbery, done right) and costs one store. The badge stays UNCONFIRMED until a second guide prints it.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: Three leads, none confirmed by a second guide. PowerPyx describes a UFO Easter egg on the road north-west of the Starlet Motel in Kelly County - after 2AM, solo, a randomly spawning car with blinking lights leads you to it. OutputLag offers two others: a glowing-graffiti code room in Crosstown, and Lucia's Chapter 2 UFO abduction strand. Try PowerPyx's first; it is the only one with a complete walkthrough.

steps.t: Go solo - PowerPyx's account requires you to be alone.
Travel at night to the road north-west of the Starlet Motel in Kelly County.
Wait until after 2AM in game time.
Watch for a car with blinking lights - the spawn is random.
If no car appears, drive away and return to re-roll the spawn.
Follow the car's path into the woods toward the bright blue light.
Reach the UFO as it drops an abducted woman.
Talk to her, offer help, and walk her back to her car.
Let the trophy pop as the encounter closes.
If the motel road never triggers, try OutputLag's Crosstown lead: the building east of the Pawn & Gun, its stairwell room of glowing graffiti and the six-digit code for the ground-floor safe.
As a third lead, follow Lucia's Chapter 2 UFO abduction strand and the Abandoned Site keypad north-east of Cottonmouth Lake.

a.t: PowerPyx: the Starlet Motel road in Kelly County, after 2AM, following a blinking car to a UFO that drops an abducted woman.

b.t: OutputLag prints two rival leads - a Crosstown graffiti code room east of the Pawn & Gun, and Lucia's abduction strand tied to the Abandoned Site north-east of Cottonmouth Lake - and confirms neither.

disputes.call: PowerPyx's first: it is the only complete, checkable walkthrough. Keep the Crosstown room as the fallback, and note the code fast if you find it - OutputLag warns the room may appear only once.

a.t: PowerPyx presents its UFO method as the solution.

b.t: GTABase, KeenGamer, EGamers, GTAScoop and GTA Zone all still list the trigger as unconfirmed.

disputes.call: Unconfirmed, with a working lead. Five lists against one method is not a settled fact - but a lead you can test beats none.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: PowerPyx's method turns the bowling joke into a number: on any bike, kick 10 pedestrians with Square within 60 seconds. Crowded Vice City pavements and Ocean Beach give you the density; save first, because ten victims in a minute brings police attention.

steps.t: Save before you start - this will raise your wanted level and your Criminal Profile.
Take any motorcycle; the method is the bike melee, not the bike.
Ride to a crowded pavement - Ocean Beach or downtown Vice City at a busy hour.
Line up a run along the pavement's edge, where pedestrians bunch.
Kick the first pedestrian with Square as you pass to start the 60-second window.
Keep kicking - ten pedestrians must fall inside the same 60 seconds.
Stay on the pavement lines and do not stop for collisions; momentum is the timer's friend.
Let the trophy pop on the tenth kick.
Escape the police afterwards and let your profile settle.
Save with the strangest Bronze on the list banked.

disputes.topic: A counted method or a vague description?

a.t: PowerPyx quantifies it: kick 10 pedestrians from a bike within 60 seconds, in a crowded area.

b.t: GTABase glosses the description as a melee attack from a vehicle knocking people down, with the exact method unconfirmed - EGamers and GTAScoop agree it is unconfirmed.

disputes.call: Use the counted method. If a plain melee drive-by were enough, the trophy would pop by accident in normal play - hunters report that it does not.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Launder a cumulative $250,000 in marked bills by selling them to your fences. The Dye Pack Jammer from Chapter 3's Credit Check makes bank and Payday Loan hauls launderable; Yasmani pays the most per bill, and vault robberies after Chapter 4 are the fastest feed of all.

steps.t: Complete Credit Check (Meet Raul's Crew) in Chapter 3 to receive the Dye Pack Jammer.
Rob a bank or Payday Loan job and take marked bills in the haul.
Sell the marked bills to a fence contact instead of spending them.
Prefer Yasmani when you can - he pays the most for marked bills.
Track the laundered total as a running figure; it accumulates across the whole run.
Feed the total with robbery work you already owe the checklist: bank jobs and Payday jobs both carry marked bills.
After Chapter 4, rob bank vaults for the richest hauls - up to $205,000 a vault, much of it marked.
Return to your fence after every big job rather than stockpiling bills.
Check the running total against the $250,000 line after each sale.
Cross $250,000 laundered and let the trophy pop.
Note the checklist separately wants $250,000 of marked bills fenced - the same money, counted once.
Save with your laundering contacts established.
Every fence sale also feeds the checklist's own fencing lines - the money is never wasted.

a.t: PowerPyx points to the vaults: after Chapter 4's mission, a single vault's marked bills move the total in minutes.

b.t: GTABase's route starts a chapter earlier, with Credit Check's Jammer and ordinary bank and Payday robberies from Chapter 3.

disputes.call: Start in Chapter 3, accelerate in Chapter 4. The total is cumulative, so early bills are never wasted.

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend a cumulative $100,000 across all shops - every kind counts. Guns, vehicle mods and tattoos burn it fastest; Push Square's tip is to find shops through Touch Pad > Style. Your garage fund ($160,000) is separate: spend on shops first if cash is tight, or earn both from the vaults.

steps.t: Open Touch Pad > Style to find shops on the map, per Push Square.
Buy weapons and ammo at Ammu-Nation - PowerPyx counts 24 of them across Leonida.
Spend at Mod Shops (14) and Pay 'n' Sprays (19) upgrading and repairing your cars.
Work the clothing (67), footwear (17), hair and beauty (18), tattoo (11) and electronics (15) shops for variety.
Remember the total is cumulative across every shop type - no single store must carry it.
Fund the spending with vault and robbery income rather than grinding small jobs.
Keep the $160,000 garage fund separate in your head; Little Boxes needs cash the shops cannot give back.
Cross $100,000 total spent and let the trophy pop.
Save with the shopping done.
Spend on your race car first - Mod Shop work counts here and raises its Rating for Earn Cash, Not Kudos.

a.t: OutputLag states the $100,000 is cumulative across every kind of shop, full stop.

b.t: GTABase steers you to the fastest burners - guns, mods and tattoos - which can read as if only they count.

disputes.call: Everything counts. The GTABase list is a speed tip, not a restriction.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Buy all eight purchasable garages in the Vice City Real Estate phone app, unlocked after Chapter 2's Daily Driver. Push Square's price list totals exactly $160,000 - Mitchel Auto Center $4,000, Persistence Road $7,600, 7th Avenue $12,000, Store n' Bolt $16,800, Wyatt Motors $21,600, Vela Rota Drive $24,000, Bonita Court $34,000, Atlantic Court $40,000. The four story-given garages do not count.

steps.t: Complete Daily Driver in Chapter 2 - the Real Estate app notification arrives with it.
Press Up, open the phone and launch the Vice City Real Estate app.
Check the eight for-sale garages against your cash; the full set costs $160,000.
Buy Mitchel Auto Center first at $4,000 - the cheapest slot.
Buy Persistence Road Garage ($7,600) and the 7th Avenue Garage ($12,000).
Buy Store n' Bolt ($16,800) and Wyatt Motors ($21,600) as robbery income lands.
Buy Vela Rota Drive Garage ($24,000) and Bonita Court Garage ($34,000).
Buy Atlantic Court Garage last at $40,000 to complete the set.
Ignore the four garages the story gives you - they never count toward the eight.
Let the trophy pop on the eighth purchase.
Save - the slots you just bought are the parking On the Spot registrations need.
At roughly $160,000 for all eight, vault income is the natural funding - rob first, buy second.

disputes.topic: One parking spot per garage, or more?

a.t: Push Square prices all eight and states each has exactly 1 parking spot - 8 slots in total, with more only via the Ultimate Edition or GTA+.

b.t: PowerPyx says each garage adds 1 or more parking spots, and OutputLag tells you to buy garages first because each registration needs a free space.

disputes.call: Buy all eight before registering cars either way. If slots run short mid-registrations, free one by replacing a stored car - the registration counter is what the trophy reads.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to Scooter Bros, the app that delivers your stored cars repaired for a fee. Moses in Port Gellhorn opens it with his Chapter 2 mission: early on he only takes untracked stolen cars (Respray, then Register); from Chapter 3, any Pay 'n' Spray registers tracked cars too. Cheap cars and bikes keep fees down, and every registration needs a free garage space.

steps.t: Complete the Chapter 2 mission Moses to receive the Scooter Bros app.
Buy garages first - each registration needs a free parking space.
Steal a cheap car with no tracker and drive it to Moses in Port Gellhorn.
At Moses' garage, choose Respray, then Register to add the car to the app.
Repeat with cheap cars and bikes - registration fees scale with the vehicle's value, so cheap is fast.
From Chapter 3, register Standard Tracker vehicles at any Pay 'n' Spray as well as at Moses.
Call Scooter Bros once to confirm a registered car is delivered to you, repaired, for its fee.
Count registrations, not stored cars - the trophy reads the app's registered total.
If a registration is refused, check for a free garage space before anything else.
Register the tenth vehicle and let the trophy pop.
Keep the app stocked - delivered cars are the fastest legal transport in free roam.
Save with the fleet registered.

disputes.topic: Register anywhere, or through Moses first?

a.t: Push Square says vehicles you are driving can be registered at any Pay 'n' Spray or Mod Shop at any time, for a value-based fee.

b.t: GTABase, PowerPyx and games.gg all describe a progression: Moses first (untracked cars only), with Pay 'n' Spray registration for tracked cars opening in Chapter 3.

disputes.call: Follow the progression - it is three sources deep and matches the app's own unlock mission. Push Square's account reads as the end-state, not the start.

a.t: Push Square's numbers create the tension openly: 8 garages with 1 spot each is 8 slots, against 10 registrations needed.

b.t: PowerPyx's garages add 1 or more spots each, which dissolves the tension - the larger garages hold more.

disputes.call: Register as you go and replace stored cars when a garage fills. The counter tracks registrations made, not cars currently stored.
